 Daniil Medvedev is in a great position to cover -5.5 games against Sho Shimabukuro, who just ended a 9-match ATP Tour main draw losing streak.
 Current Form:
 Daniil Medvedev is coming off a prolific Asian swing, compiling an 11-2 record and reaching at least the semifinals of three tournaments. Medvedev also captured the Hangzhou Open title, beating Andrey Rublev 7-5, 6-4 in the final.
 Sho Shimabukuro ended a 9-match main draw losing streak with a 6-7, 6-4, 6-4 win over Roman Safiullin. Shimabukuro overcame Safiullin's 18 aces by converting three break points on 30 return points.
 The Matchup: Medvedev is a -1580 favorite over Shimabukuro in their first meeting on the ATP Tour.

 Our Daniil Medvedev vs Sho Shimabukuro Prediction
 The Difference Maker: Medvedev is just in a different class from Shimabukuro. Not only is he a former world No.1 and a Grand Slam champion, but Medvedev is also riding a huge wave of momentum into Almaty.
 What to Expect: Medvedev bulldozes Shimabukuro to cover -5.5 games.
